# Alpha Global EU

> Alpha Global EU – your B2B partner in Europe. E-commerce distribution, fulfilment, wholesale and import from China to the European market. Warsaw, Poland.

Alpha Global EU is the trading name of ALPHA GLOBAL Sp. z o.o., a B2B company based in Warsaw, Poland.
We are your single point of contact for e-commerce distribution, fulfilment and logistics across the European market.

## Services

- **E-Commerce & Sales**: Active sales channels on European e-commerce platforms. We handle listings, orders, customer service and returns. (FBA, FBM, Fulfilment, Order handling)
- **Wholesale & Distribution**: Wholesale distribution to dealers, retail chains and B2B partners across Europe. Flexible terms and direct cooperation.
- **Import & Sourcing**: Direct sourcing of goods and spare parts — quality control, transport coordination and customs clearance handled by us.

## Active sales channels

- Amazon EU (FBA, FBM, Pan-EU)
- Allegro PL (marketplace, fulfilment)
- B2B wholesale (PL, DE, EU; import from China)

## For manufacturers

We are open to working with manufacturers seeking a distribution channel in the Polish and European market. We add your products to our range and distribute them across multiple channels.

1. We take on your product: Your product enters our range and is actively distributed in selected markets.
2. Multi-channel distribution: We manage multiple online and offline sales channels — one partner, multiple markets.
3. Direct contact, individual terms: Every partnership is discussed individually — no templates, full commitment.

## Why Alpha Global EU

- Reliability: We meet deadlines. We communicate clearly. No surprises.
- Fast execution: Flat structures, quick decisions — from enquiry to action without unnecessary bureaucracy.
- Direct contact: You talk to the people who actually fulfil your order.
- Fair terms: Direct relationships with suppliers and partners — no unnecessary middlemen.
